_note: Every count, probability and date the app uses. Researchers change them here, never in code. Counts per person are cue-carrying cards; each family adds `baselinePerFamily` all-baseline presentations per form. The counts follow research plan v2 (19 Oct 2026, section 1.1), which supersedes v1's; planning values are marked: P1's pilot replaces them (plan v1, 7.4). Change a count here and run `pnpm length` and `pnpm check`.

timing._source: plan-scripts/cap_fit.py, planning values in seconds at the 80th percentile of players, none sourced; P1 replaces them

targets._source: research plan v2, 1.1 and 1.2 (the panel as two games; the firm with two conduct rematch cards)

panel-g1._layout: Plan v2 1.1. Form A then the screening block for FULL players. Low scorers: the honest survey, the note (faking or honest retake, 1:1), form B, the survey again, the recall item. High scorers: Off the Record (M1-H's random subsample takes the statement route; every other high scorer takes neutral privacy items of the same length). R1's partial arms: form A in their arm, then the wrap. No rematch in game 1 (plan v2 1.2).

panel-g2._layout: Plan v2 1.1. Conduct cards (M3's halves), Off the Record (M5's practice, M3's items, module RC for a random share, padded otherwise), the Committee Inbox (24 cards, language per card), the note (a or b, 1:1, unstratified: game 2 has no screening block), form B, the survey once, the recall item.

firm._layout: Plan v2 1.1 and 3: as plan v1, with two conduct rematch cards (S5's consistency guard). S2's Inbox is 42 cards (21 harassment, 21 near-miss), not plan v2's 44: this build counts two things cap_fit_v2.py does not, the Inbox's content-note screen (15 s) and the direct block's four repeat pairs, and at 44 the session is 30.6 minutes. The Inbox gives two cards at a time (PF-18) until it fits.

split._note: PLANNING VALUE. The screening block's fairness score (0 unfair to 1 fair) below which a player is a low scorer. P1 fixes it at its pilot's 30th percentile.

m1h._note: PLANNING VALUE: share of high scorers drawn into M1-H's statement route.

m3._note: PLANNING VALUES (PO-1): the floor quantile q and the permutation counts.

rc._note: PLANNING VALUE: share of Game 2 players who also take module RC.

firmWindows._note: Blocked by firm and training month: permuted blocks, size drawn per block from blockSizes, each block half before and half after.

release._note: DEMO dates. Each deployment's release date is the day after its whole play window closes.

season._note: The season story (EVAL-4, EVAL-5: the owner's 80-decision layout, Game 1's low branch as the demo route). Every key listed in pendingV18 is a PLANNING VALUE set by the builder or taken from the 80-decision scenario: v18 fixes it. None is final, and none may be used with participants until v18 registers it.
season._splitCapNote: EVAL-10 (owner): each split card sets its own pool (4 to 12, PENDING v26, which registers the variation); the per-person cap is the pool times splitCapShare, rounded, and never under a third of the pool, so an even split (or a near-even one) is always possible.

rating._note: PENDING v18. Computed on all 57 rating cards. A cue's level comes from its permutation p against rating.levels: the cast's cues against every balanced relabelling of the cast, caste and birthplace against sign flips of the one-off pairs (exact up to 2^12, else `permutations` draws). Not enough to say below minPairs decisive pairs, or when the player followed the notes in under engagementMin of clear pairs.

levels._note: PENDING v20 (the research design sets these). Five reading levels (owner decision O2, 19 Oct 2026) from the cue's permutation p: strong when p is at most 1 - strong, moderate at most 1 - moderate, possible at most 1 - possible; otherwise no lean read, or not enough to say. Demo values are the permutation quantiles 0.99, 0.95 and 0.85. 'Moderate' is the old single lean threshold (q). Never shown to players.

range._pending: PENDING v22: v22 redesigns the reading to strict targets and will likely use a posterior model. These are planning values for the position-with-range display (EVAL-10): the share of equal woman-and-man pairs where the woman came first (an even share counts half), with the equal-tailed interval holding `mass` of a Beta(prior + women first, prior + men first) posterior ('beta'), or the Wilson score interval ('wilson'). Never shown with this marker; the screens show the dot and the range only.

untagged._pending: PENDING v26: the always-show rule (owner, 20 Oct 2026) and the research critic's adjustment. An untagged reading (still forming, or not yet confirmed) shows its range as the mark, the point hollow or left out (`point`), and the range in words from `words` (edges between mostly men-first, slightly men-first, about equal, slightly women-first and mostly women-first). How many seasons a reading needs before it is tagged is season.profile.readings (EVAL-12). Planning values; the research design sets them.

timing._note: PENDING v18. The scenario's per-type paces (sim_scenario80.py length): a tap-to-order or tap-to-give card 20 s, a grid item 5 s, a single-choice item 6 s, the probe 10 s, an ordinary decision 10 s, the note 15 s, 80 s of fixed overhead; plus this build's own: a pick of two colleagues 12 s, each episode card and interlude, the opening, the season's end, the debrief, the code, demographics and submit.

change._note: PENDING v17. The profile reads a change between two saved seasons only when the headline weight moved by at least minDiff (on the -1 to +1 scale). A planning value: v17 sets the rule, ideally from the retake arm's test-retest agreement.

profile._pending: EVAL-12 (owner, 20 Oct 2026); every value PENDING research design v26, config only, never shown as pending. `readings`: the profile's readings in order, each with the registered season count at which its pooled reading may be tagged (`opens`; null: no count meets the targets yet, shown as 'not available yet'). v25 registered tone 2, religion 3, conduct 3, hiring and promotion 4, resource sharing 4 and role 6; the owner's brief sets the values below for v26. `pooling`: how the seasons since the last restart combine, 'equal' (v25, section 3.18: equal weights, the pooled variance the sum of the seasons' variances over k squared) or 'inverse-variance' (v22, withdrawn in v23 because it inflated an area reading's pooled false rate). `reliableChange`: the faster change rule's threshold on the latest season's estimate minus the pool's, over the root of the sum of their variances; 2.576 is two-sided 0.01 on the normal (v25 uses Student's t on the latest season's degrees of freedom, which this build's share estimate does not carry). When it fires, that season is shown as the change, untagged, and is not pooled; the pool starts on the next season (v24). `storiesTotal`: stories in the catalogue, each played once per profile.

season._retakeNote: PENDING v17. retakeGapDays: null means no gap. When v17 sets a number, the profile shows the day the next retake opens as a date, never as a countdown.

cards._note: PENDING v17. A domain's blind-spot card for a cue needs at least minPairs equal pairs there with at least share of them one way; the even card needs minPairs with the two sides within one.

counted._note: PENDING v18. The owner's 80 counted decisions: 4 mascot cards, 4 screening items, 15 faking-test decisions (4 + 6 + 4 + 1), 57 rating cards (19 per domain). Entry, wrap and ordinary decisions are asked but not counted.

faking._note: PENDING v18. Game 1's low branch at the scenario's S4 split: the screening block's 4 items on one grid, the survey's 4 items (two per family, keyed two and two) on one grid before and after the note, 6 form-B cards, the recall item.

cueCarriers._note: PENDING v18, which decides it: the fixed cast of 8 carries sex, religion and skin tone; caste and birthplace ride on one-off characters (applicants, complainants, vendors) inside the episodes.

domains._note: PENDING v18. Each domain panel reads sex on its own 19 cards with the same floor, at minPairs or more decisive pairs.

chapters._pending: PENDING v21: every value here is a planning value until research plan v21 registers the chapter structure (owner approval, 20 Oct 2026, concepts A, B1, C and D). Never shown with this marker; the screens show the numbers only.
